description: Evaluation questions for the lecture assistant, written from the files of ai/samples-in as indexed on 2026-11-23 (one course per file). Not run yet.

fields.question: the student's question, as typed
fields.type: text | visual | cross_language | not_found | follow_up | colloquial | permission
fields.follows: follow_up only: the id of the previous question in the same conversation (ask it first)
fields.courses: the courses the student may search (permission questions: the answer is only in a course that is not listed)
fields.sources: the correct file and page/slide; an answer is right when it cites at least one of them. Empty for not_found
fields.must_include: facts the answer must contain, copied exactly as written in the source (numbers, English terms, Arabic phrases). Every item is required
fields.any_of: optional: groups of alternatives, at least one item of each group must appear
fields.note: why the question is there, or what makes it hard
fields.answer_in: permission only: where the answer is, in a course the student may not search

scoring: answered: status answered (or needs_review), at least one expected source cited, every must_include item present (numbers compared by value, text without diacritics; a term of the shared glossary also matches its Arabic meaning or an accepted wording). not_found: status not_found and no invented content.

questions.question: What's the formula for the standard error of the sample means, and what do its letters stand for?
any_of: standard deviation of the whole population
questions.note: Formula with symbols; the answer must keep the formula as written.

questions.question: In the second example, what's the chance that a student gets a score between 350 and 400?
questions.note: Several numbers on the slide (z1, z2, p1, p2): the answer must give the final probability, not an intermediate value.

questions.question: In the Aramex challenge, how likely is it that the Cessna can take all 36 boxes from Amman to Cairo?
questions.note: The question is on slide 20, the answer on slide 21: retrieval must reach the solution slide. F01 follows this question.

questions.question: When they asked five retirees at random, what average retirement age did that first sample give?
questions.note: Slide 13 gives the population mean (65); the answer must give the first sample's mean, not 65.

questions.question: Which techniques does the chapter mention for keeping data integrity?
questions.note: List answer from one page.

questions.question: How much ransom was paid in the Colonial Pipeline case, and when did it happen?
questions.note: A money amount and a year from the same example.

questions.question: The SolarWinds hack is given as an example of which type of attack?
questions.note: The term is in the last line of the page, after the description.

questions.question: Back in the mainframe days, what was security mostly about?
questions.note: Page 14 has three eras; the answer must take the mainframe era (1970s - 1980s), not the 1990s or 2000s.

questions.question: How many people got cancer and how many died from it worldwide in 2022?
questions.note: Two figures; the source says they are estimates.

questions.question: Are there any infections that can lead to cancer?
questions.note: A yes/no question whose answer needs the named infections. 'infections' could also match malware words in the security course.

questions.question: ما المقصود بطباق السلب؟ وأعطني مثالاً عليه من المحاضرة.
questions.note: Arabic question on an Arabic file. Slide 8 has another example (جزعت ولم أجزع).

questions.question: كم عدد الطلبة ذوي الإعاقة المتقدمين في العام الجامعي 2021/2022، وكم نسبة المكفوفين والصم بينهم؟
questions.note: The numbers are headings on the page, apart from their sentences.

questions.question: بالرسم اللي بسلايد Z-Score، شو النسبة المكتوبة على المنطقة الواقعة بين 1σ و 2σ؟
questions.note: Only in the image description (labels 34.1% 13.6% 2.1% 0.1%). Not the calibration question (between -1 and +1). The model must not add up or reinterpret the labels.

questions.question: What did Reem Basel get in Mathematics?
questions.note: From the table. The row also has 96, 93 and 97: the answer must pick the right column. The sheet is in 3 chunks; the table is in parts 2 and 3.

questions.question: في أي فصل من السنة يتم قطف الزيتون وعصره؟
questions.note: From the table «مراحل موسم الزيتون». Ripening (النضج) is also in autumn: the answer must give the harvest row.

questions.question: في جدول المقارنة مع المنافسين، هل Note Depot فيه تحويل الكلام إلى نص؟
questions.note: The table uses ✓ and ✗; the answer is no (✗). A yes is a wrong answer.

questions.question: ماذا يحدث للخطأ المعياري عندما نكبّر حجم العينة، وما أثر ذلك على تقدير متوسط المجتمع؟
questions.note: Arabic question, English slide. Glossary: standard error = الخطأ المعياري, sample size = حجم العينة, population mean = متوسط المجتمع.

questions.question: كيف نستخدم الدرجة المعيارية لنكتشف القيم المتطرفة في البيانات؟
questions.note: Glossary: z-score = الدرجة المعيارية, outlier = القيمة المتطرفة. The answer should give the steps and the usual cutoff 3.

questions.question: كيف تضمن المؤسسة أن تبقى أنظمتها ومعلوماتها متاحة لمستخدميها دائماً؟ وما الوسائل المذكورة للتوافر؟
questions.note: Glossary: availability = التوافر. F02 follows this question.

questions.question: ما هي الخزعة، ومتى يُلجأ إليها في تشخيص السرطان؟
questions.note: «الخزعة» is not in the glossary: only the embeddings can link it to 'biopsy'. The source says only 'sometimes'; the answer must not invent when it is used.

questions.question: ما الفرق بين التهديد الداخلي المتعمّد والتهديد الداخلي غير المقصود؟
questions.note: Glossary: insider threat = التهديد الداخلي. A comparison of two items on one page.

questions.question: How do I build a 95% confidence interval for the population mean using the CLT?
questions.note: Very close to the chapter (CLT, sampling distribution, 95% in the Empirical Rule, standard error) but confidence intervals are never covered. Easy to answer from general knowledge: a trap.

questions.question: What is a man-in-the-middle attack and how can encryption stop it?
questions.note: Encryption and attacks are both in the chapter (confidentiality, ransomware), but man-in-the-middle is not.

questions.question: كم لتر زيت تعطي شجرة الزيتون الواحدة في السنة تقريباً؟
questions.note: The file talks about oil production and a world production chart, but gives no yield per tree (and the chart has no numbers in the text). Any number is invented.

questions.question: What is the survival rate for cancer when it is detected early?
questions.note: Early detection and figures (20 million, 9.7 million) are in the file, but no survival rate. Any percentage is invented.

questions.question: How big can the GDPR fine be for a company that doesn't comply?
questions.note: Page 12 names GDPR and says non-compliance results in 'massive fines', but gives no amount. Correct: say the amount is not in the lectures (stating only 'massive fines' with its source is acceptable; any amount is a failure).

questions.question: وليش قسمنا 2,630 على عدد الصناديق؟ شو بتمثل النتيجة؟
questions.note: Ask after T03 in the same conversation. «عدد الصناديق» refers to the 36 boxes of the previous answer.

questions.question: وما مثال الاختراق الذي ذكرته المحاضرة لهذا المبدأ؟
questions.note: Ask after A03. «هذا المبدأ» is availability: an example of a confidentiality or integrity breach (pages 5, 6) is wrong.

questions.question: شو يعني طباق الايجاب؟ اعطيني مثال عليه
questions.note: Levantine wording, and «الايجاب» without hamza (the slide writes «الإيجاب»).

questions.question: wats the diffrence betwen data security and infosec in the chapter??
questions.note: English spelling mistakes (wats, diffrence, betwen) that keyword search will not match; the answer needs pages 9 and 10.

questions.question: ما الفرق بين الطباق والمقابلة؟ وأيهما أشمل؟
questions.note: The answer is in ARABIC-TIBAQ (slides 3-4), which this student does not take. Nothing from that course may be retrieved or cited.

questions.question: في أي فصل تزهر شجرة الزيتون، وكيف تبدو أزهارها؟
questions.note: The answer is in AGRI-OLIVE (spring, small flowers); the student only takes HEALTH-CANCER.
